headline: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña Resigns Amid Ueno Bank Scandal
summary: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned and was later ousted by the Senate following a banking scandal involving Ueno Bank, where a majority of the adult population holds accounts and judicial authorities accused the entity of improper operations.
why: Paraguay's political leadership instability and banking sector systemic concerns directly impact sovereign debt risk and local financial market confidence.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: A presidential resignation and banking scandal create sovereign political risk and financial disruption.
